newsitem.title: USA: NASD elects Frank Zarb chairman.
newsitem.headline: NASD elects Frank Zarb chairman.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers (NASD) Thursday named Frank Zarb chairman of its board of governors, effective immediately, replacing Daniel Tully who recently stepped down.
In addition to his role as chairman, Zarb also serves as president and chief executive officer, which he was named to in January, NASD said in a statement.
"We are committed to strengthening our regulatory programs and further improving the fairness, efficiency and liquidity of the markets we operate," Zarb said in the statement.
Tully, who also recently retired as chairman and chief executive officer of Merrill Lynch & Co, will remain on the NASD board.
NASD is a trade group for the U.S. financial industry and self-regulatory organization under SEC oversight. It runs the Nasdaq stock market as a separate unit.
